events.title: Demo Update — Talent Compass, Wishlist Gift & Achievements
events.summary: Added a one-time support gift: visit the main game’s Steam store from the Talent Compass or your first victory/defeat result screen to receive 300 Stardust and 25 Warranty Crowns. One claim per save; wishlist membership is not checked. Talent purchases and resets are restricted to outside active runs, including suspended runs. The map utility and pause-menu shortcut now open the Encyclopedia. Clarified the Talent Compass return button as “Return to Main Menu”. Added a clearly visible Achievement

events.title: The Stop Reading the Cards Demo Is Out Now!
events.summary: Hello everyone! The free demo for Stop Reading the Cards is now available on Steam. Stop Reading the Cards is a satirical single-player deckbuilding roguelike. Build a deck, define its action priorities, and watch your strategy run in automated battles. Your job is to design combos, adjust the rules, and look like you planned it when things go wrong. Visit our store page and download the demo The game is still in development, and we'd love to hear how your run went. Which combinations were fun?
